name: Essence Backlash
body:
When you counter an enemy spell, some of the dissipating energy is redirected to your opponent.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Counterspell.

Benefit: Whenever you successfully counter a spell, or dispel an ongoing effect with dispel magic (or greater dispel magic) the caster of the effect takes damage equal to twice the level of the spell that you countered or dispelled. This requires you to have line of effect to the caster of the effect you countered or dispelled.
